ms.report:
This was a big milestone. We finalized the curriculum, all front end and back end development, and all translation tasks. We set up a weekly support call for user support. We soft-launched and tested the DID solution, learning curriculum, and learner rewards. Bug fixes were identified and fixed in the soft launch phase, and we have rolled straight into full launch in the past week -- there are currently already more than 300 learners who have gotten a DID credential, and about 150 learners are logging in per day to take the course. Artifacts relating to the fully built program are detailed below as defined for this milestone:

ms.report:
The program has had it's full public launch and is wildly popular! We have had a few support requests, but we can see that hundreds of users are participating every day: Getting their ProofSpace DID, reading articles, taking quizzes, and collecting rewards. For this milestone we were looking to get 500 active users, but it has gone so fast we are already up to 950 DID-verified users! 
Below you can check out the live website, and our marketing efforts, as planned for this milestone. (We really didn't need to do the marketing in order to get users -- word spread QUICKLY!! But it was still a good exercise to spread the word and raise awareness of Cardano!)
The Proofspace Dashboard linked here shows ~1200 DIDs verified. This reflects that some portion of users get confused when they are getting their DID, and they issue themselves more than one DID for the program. This does not allow them to participate multiple times... it's just multiple DIDs on their single device, which still allows them to participate one time! On the Lido Nation dashboard below the proofspace screen shot, you can see that the actual number of DID-verified users is about 950!
・Link to program website: https://www.lidonation.com/sw/earn/learn
・Copy of email marketing and Twitter: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1SA5mEu7ulL50zBn8hHB1INOcPh05EIGES1huyDS8JL8/edit?usp=sharing
・Show Proofspace Dashboard showing how many total VCs have been issued: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MNmP400s4wUFigOt97Ub07AomHkIAHvTMg1ECv6AUL8/edit?usp=sharing
